text:
maria: Quick share — ran the fallback simulator against the new CB logic for Premium/Standard tiers. Results attached inline. TL;DR: Premium latency SLOs hold if we raise CB threshold to 40% error rate for model-variant fallback, but cost spikes on Standard due to more fallbacks.

aj: can you paste the sim config/output?

maria: pasted config below:

```
policy:
  tiers:
    premium:
      latency_slo_ms: 200
      cb_error_pct: 40
      fallback_order: [vX-quant, vX-fp16, vY-llm]
    standard:
      latency_slo_ms: 400
      cb_error_pct: 20
      fallback_order: [vX-fp16, vY-llm]
  region_fallbacks:
    eu:
      prefer_local_variant: true
```

devin: notable: standard's cb at 20% tripped frequently in eu-west when load spike + cold KV cache. Did you model KV cache warmups?

maria: yes, I ran warm/cold mixes: 70% warm. With 30% cold, premiums still ok; standard drop in availability to 92% for some customers.

sam: 92% availability for standard is below our SLO for paid tiers. Need to throttle or queue not to blow up tail latency.

nicole: UX/Console ask: can we show per-tier 'fallback burn rate' on the model page? e.g., % requests rerouted to lower-quality variants + cost delta. Designers want a heatmap.

aj: For API changes, prefer adding `x-redwood-priority` header for route service. Example: `x-redwood-priority: premium` so edge can short-circuit routing without full policy lookup.

marco (sre-bot): deploy-bot: we observed CB flips on 03/12 02:12 UTC — auto rollback triggered. Logs: `cb:premium: tripped->closed`

maria: Action items: 1) tune standard cb to 25% and add short cooldown (15s) 2) add console metric 'fallback_rate' per tier+region 3) add header opt-in for fast-path. Anyone object?

devin: +1 for metrics and header. But cooldown 15s might mask real persistent failures. Suggest exponential backoff up to 2m.

sam: also update the rollout playbook to include 'quarantine' flag for noisy customers (route them to dedicated pool) — can product agree?

nicole: Product ok to add 'quarantine' but needs admin UI control and audit logs.

maria: I'll open PR with sim artifacts and a rough API change; tagging @aj for API review and @nicole for Console follow-up.
